exposure: In vitro fertilization (IVF) status (IVF vs. non-IVF)
outcome: Antenatal suspicion of Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS)
cohort: The study included 692 pregnancies with pathologically confirmed Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS), comprising 44 IVF pregnancies and 648 non-IVF pregnancies, observed between 1998 and 2021.
finding: Pregnant individuals with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) who underwent IVF were less likely to have an antenatal suspicion of PAS and exhibited less severe pathological disease compared with non-IVF patients.
mod_finding: The IVF group was less likely to have had a prior cesarean delivery (70.5%) compared with the non-IVF group (91%).
